title: Partnership to LLP Conversion — Professional Services Sector
metaTitle: Partnership to LLP Conversion Overview | NRSR & Co
metaDesc: An overview of the conversion of a partnership firm to a Limited Liability Partnership in the professional services sector.
metaKeywords: LLP Conversion, Partnership Firm, Professional Services
summary: A registered partnership firm in the professional services sector was converted into a Limited Liability Partnership.
challenge: The partners of the firm wished to convert their registered partnership into a Limited Liability Partnership, requiring consent documentation and statutory filings with the Ministry of Corporate Affairs.
solution: The engagement covered obtaining Digital Signature Certificates and Designated Partner Identification Numbers for partners, name reservation, incorporation filings, and the conversion filing under Form 17.
execution: Filings were prepared and submitted in sequence, followed by post-conversion updates to the entity's PAN, bank accounts, and GST registration to reflect the new LLP structure.
